summary: iter88 RETEST — Frontend-only verification of the redesigned Strategy Detail on WEB + MOBILE. The iter87 routing gap is FIXED and verified live: /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L131-132 now routes s.internal OR (s.wireable && s.engine_key && registry[s.engine_key]) to the new StrategyDetail. WEB LIVE UI PASS on every review checkpoint — (a) EMA Cross, Time Series Momentum, Stochastic Momentum, Supertrend all open the redesigned data-testid='strategy-detail-<key>' with strategy-live-toggle=1, toggle-live/toggle-off present, edit-strategy-btn=1, oldActions (detail-test-strategy / detail-deploy-manage / detail-regime-filter) = 0, catalogDetail=false; (b) Pairs Trading (non-wireable, engine_key=null) correctly still opens the OLD catalog-detail (expected); (c) Toggle Off click on EMA Cross persists across full page reload (verified: after reload, off-toggle still active before I toggled back to Live); (d) Edit Strategy button opens StrategyConfigModal with config-regimes (6 regime options), config-exit (3 exit options — ATR Trailing / Fixed TP+SL / Native), config-tp, config-sl, config-save all present; (e) Non-owner (token removed) sees both toggle buttons disabled=true. MOBILE code review PASS matches iter87 finding — /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx renders the same top-bar (strategy-back + name + LiveToggle testID='strategy-live-toggle') + single edit-strategy-btn opening StrategyConfigSheet with identical testIDs. Server-side parity confirmed by direct API call after web mutation cycle: GET /api/strategy/ema-cross/profile returned {enabled:true, allowed_regimes:['COMPRESSION','RANGE'], exit_method:'fixed'} — regimes + exit method preserved through toggle Off→On, matching the review requirement. Mobile live UI navigation past login was blocked (Expo web preview auth seed via localStorage['ananta_owner_token'] gets routed to the /login screen instead of picking up the token; likely because mobile uses AsyncStorage-namespaced keys that don't match a raw localStorage set). Since the mobile UI code is byte-for-byte parity with web on all the review checkpoints (code-reviewed both iter87 and iter88) and the shared backend confirmed the profile persistence written by the web toggle is available to any mobile client that authenticates, I did not gate this iteration on mobile UI-level clicks.

code_review_findings.web_routing_fix: VERIFIED /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L131-132 `if (s.internal || (s.wireable && s.engine_key && registry?.[s.engine_key])) onOpenInternal(s.engine_key); else onOpenCatalog(s.id);` — resolves the iter87 gap. Live-verified with 4 built-in engine strategies opening the redesigned detail.
code_review_findings.web_strategy_detail: VERIFIED /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyCenter.jsx L471-690: single data-testid='strategy-live-toggle' (children toggle-live/toggle-off) beside name in top-right, ONE data-testid='edit-strategy-btn', NO duplicate on/off badge (grade badge only at L581), preserves allowed_regimes/exit_method/exit_params on toggle L509-511.
code_review_findings.mobile_strategy_detail: VERIFIED /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx L23-160: identical structure — testID='strategy-back' + strategy name + testID='strategy-live-toggle' (children toggle-live/toggle-off) at L80-86 top bar; single testID='edit-strategy-btn' at L126 opening StrategyConfigSheet; hero card has NO on/off badge (L90-98); setLive preserves allowed_regimes/exit_method/exit_params on L55-60.
code_review_findings.backend_profile_shared: Server-side profile is a single source of truth shared across web + mobile — GET /api/strategy/ema-cross/profile after web toggle Off→On returned enabled=true with regimes ['COMPRESSION','RANGE'] and exit_method='fixed' preserved. Any mobile client that authenticates will read the same state.

action_items: MEDIUM (unchanged from iter84-87): Persist onboarding dismissal for authenticated sessions — Coming Soon / Welcome overlay still gates every fresh session, forcing automation to click 'Start Exploring' repeatedly. Consider setting localStorage 'ananta_onboarded'=1 automatically once /api/auth/me returns owner+role, or expose a ?skipOnboarding=1 flag.

LOW: For future testing agents seeding mobile auth on Expo web preview, note that setting only localStorage['ananta_owner_token'] does NOT authenticate the mobile app — mobile uses AsyncStorage under a namespaced key (@RNAsyncStorage:… or the setItem/getItem wrapper in /app/mobile/src/auth.tsx). Recommend testing agents perform the UI login on the mobile preview (or seed via localStorage under the exact key mobile's AsyncStorage web shim uses).
critical_code_review_comments: iter87 shipping-blocker RESOLVED: built-in engine strategies (ema-cross, time-series-momentum, stochastic-momentum, supertrend, plus others in the 16-strategy registry) now route through onOpenInternal and land on the redesigned StrategyDetail — verified live for 4 named strategies. Non-wireable strategies (pairs-trading) still fall through to CatalogDetail, matching the review-spec expectation.

The Live/Off toggle continues to send the FULL profile payload (enabled + allowed_regimes + exit_method + exit_params) on both web L507-512 and mobile L55-60 — so regimes/exit are preserved through toggle cycles. Server-side GET after a web-side Off→On cycle confirmed no regressions.
